## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      1 avis récent mentionne prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 24 août 2026 - 25 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _rudie.cant.fail_, 24 août 2026, 4/5: "Great app with a lot of good free features but a lot of things are behind a paywall"
            2. _SmartRater_, 25 sept. 2026, 5/5: "Tick tick is an amazing app that has helped me get organize all my tasks for school. While some features are locked behind a paywall there are still a plethora of free features that should be more than enough for you to be more successful. Highly recommend."

## **Pression publicitaire** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Pression publicitaire.**
      1 avis récent mentionne pression publicitaire.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 17 août 2026 - 17 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs remarquent la pression publicitaire. Cela signale une friction de monétisation et une ouverture pour un concurrent plus propre.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Albro17_, 17 août 2026, 5/5: "Incredibly helpful in the ongoing battle against procrastination. I use it every day to keep track of my working hours, and bring order to the chaos that is being self-employed. The app's interface is refreshingly clean, there's a myriad of useful features and no annoying ads anywhere (I'm using the free version). One of those rare examples where the developers seem to have prioritised functionality over monetisation. Wouldn't wanna spend a day without it."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      1 avis récent mentionne bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 24 juin 2026 - 27 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _@mzz..._, 24 juin 2026, 1/5: "Best app I have found for productivity. But there are some bugs/errors in the app, which even after giving feedback about it, won’t be solved. Some bugs have been here for more than 3 years!!! They also won’t do anything with your feature requests, so don't bother. Eventhough this is the best app I found, I can't recommend it to anyone because of the terrible support. I already raised every bug to the developers and they keep repeating the same message. 3 years later “we are still looking into it” Also is devolving for timetracking so don’t bother if you want to use it for that."
            2. _Graceful_yogi_, 27 sept. 2026, 2/5: "I like the app but constantly running into bugs. Not stable. On iPad, it just closed on its own. One time it moved all my tasks into trash. Running into errors while creating new lists and support has given up too as to why."
<!--/ir-theme-->
